title: acer tataricum var. semenovii
intro: Acer tataricum var. semenovii, commonly known as the Tatarian maple or Semenov's maple, is a deciduous shrub or small tree belonging to the family Sapindaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of hypertension, diabetes, and inflammation, due to its therapeutic actions such as vasodilation, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. These compounds are believed to contribute to the plant's potential therapeutic uses in the prevention and treatment of various diseases.
